message.content: {"note_claim": "The Dream game at State Farm Arena drew an attendance of about 9,745 in a limited, lower-level-only configuration with the upper deck closed.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "But nearly 10,000 Dream fans were, and that should cause eyebrows to arch.", "reason": "The column confirms a crowd of nearly 10,000 at State Farm Arena (capacity 17,044), but the legible text does not state 9,745 or the tarped upper deck, and the garbled text appears to show a different figure (9,685)."}

parsed.note_claim: The Dream game at State Farm Arena drew an attendance of about 9,745 in a limited, lower-level-only configuration with the upper deck closed.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: But nearly 10,000 Dream fans were, and that should cause eyebrows to arch.
parsed.reason: The column confirms a crowd of nearly 10,000 at State Farm Arena (capacity 17,044), but the legible text does not state 9,745 or the tarped upper deck, and the garbled text appears to show a different figure (9,685).
